transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling incredibly depressed, sad, and completely empty inside for the past nine months. I have no motivation left at all, and I've lost interest in absolutely everything in my life.
Have you felt depressed most days for at least two years, or has this been a new episode lasting less than two years?
It has been less than two years. I've been feeling this way constantly for about nine months now.
Have you had any changes in your sleep, like sleeping much more or much less than usual?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep patterns. For the most part, my sleep has been relatively normal.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite or weight, like eating much less or more than usual?
Yes, I've barely had any appetite at all, and it has been like that almost every day. Because of that, I've lost a noticeable amount of weight recently without even trying to diet.
Have you been feeling especially worthless or excessively guilty about yourself nearly every day?
No, I haven't really been feeling worthless or guilty about anything. It is more that I just feel completely empty and sad most of the time.
Have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or wanting to die. I just feel incredibly empty and down, but I don't have those kinds of thoughts.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities nearly every day, even things you used to enjoy?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in almost everything, including the hobbies I used to love. I just feel a total lack of enjoyment or satisfaction in anything I do lately. It all feels completely flat.
Based on your symptoms, this is most consistent with Major Depressive Disorder.

That makes sense to me, as I've been struggling with this deep depression for nine months now. However, I also sometimes hear voices and have strange beliefs, but only when my depression is at its absolute worst. Are those scary experiences also a part of this diagnosis?
When you hear voices or have those strange beliefs, do they only happen during the worst depressive episodes, or do they ever happen when your mood is otherwise normal?
They only happen when I am feeling deeply depressed and down. I never hear those voices or have those strange beliefs when my mood is normal.
